added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own arm logs: the reviewed run recorded baseline_suite: null and after_suite: null (see run classification.json), so no base/head arm pair exists and no failure can be shown added. findings.text: follow-on: commit 952e1ce3 folds a whole-file ruff reformat (many blank-line removals) into the settle mechanics, so the feature commit's diff carries reformatting of lines it did not otherwise touch.

follow-on: the manifest records no baseline_suite or after_suite arm logs (both null in classification.json), so the done_when clause that the existing session-host and follower tests show no added failure against base is asserted but not evidenced.

follow-on: _check_settle judges the whole project-wide population with session=None, while the section's deliverable text says "when the session has no live run"; the done_when's peer case requires the project-wide reading, so the two readings conflict and the coordinator should confirm the intended scope.

follow-on: the saw_live hinge means a follower armed after its session's last run already reached a terminal phase never settles and holds the pane open until its lifetime expires, which is intended for the dispatch window but is a lingering-pane edge a reader may see.
